Beyond VM automation, I bring experience with legacy ITSM automation (HP OO, HP SA) and modern cloud-native integrations.

I’m eager to leverage my expertise in Terraform, Azure, and automation frameworks to help enterprises drive digital transformation, improve delivery velocity, and achieve reliable, secure infrastructure deployments.
